title: Crypto derivatives volume explode to $86T in 2025, averaging $265B per day
summary: Crypto derivatives trading surged to $86 trillion in 2025, averaging $265 billion per day, as Binance captured almost 30% of global volume, CoinGlass reported.

title: CZ proposes fix to address poisoning after investor loses $50M
summary: Zhao urged the blockchain industry to adopt new security measures, including scam address blacklist, after an investor lost $50 million to an address poisoning scheme.

title: NFT collections get no Santa rally as market hits 2025 lows
summary: Market data showed shrinking participation across NFTs, with fewer buyers, sellers and transactions signaling fading speculative interest.

title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $825M in five days as US becomes 'biggest seller' of BTC
summary: Bitcoin ETF performance remained negative on Christmas Eve as a short final US trading session produced another $175 million in net outflows.

title: Social engineering cost crypto billions in 2025: How to protect yourself
summary: Crypto hackers took social engineering to a whole other level this year, and advances in artificial intelligence mean scams are about to get even harder to detect.

title: Bitcoiners bullish over Elon Musk tipping ‘double-digit’ economic growth
summary: Elon Musk added that “triple-digit” economic growth could even be possible by 2030; however, some Bitcoiners worry about a 2026 bear market.

title: Crypto mergers and acquisitions hit record $8.6B in 2025: FT
summary: The number of crypto deals reportedly skyrocketed this year and hit a record total value of $8.6 billion, led by Coinbase’s record-breaking acquisition of Deribit.

title: Solana and Ethereum can coexist in tokenization race: Dragonfly VC
summary: Dragonfly’s Rob Hadick says “there’s a lot of room” in crypto for more than one blockchain as networks race to win market share of tokenized assets.

title: Polymarket says third-party provider caused reported account breaches
summary: Some Polymarket users reported that their accounts had been breached and drained, which the prediction market blamed on a third-party provider.

title: Tokenization has moved past money only meaning fiat: Kraken exec
summary: Blockchain tokenization is radically expanding the definition of money, enabling anyone to trade, save and spend in virtually any asset they like, says Kraken’s Mark Greenberg.
